purpose: Validate availability and identity of standalone whole-frame CPU/GPU timing samples; inspect repeat variability without claiming PCF cost or a speedup.
owner: Assistant implementing and executing under the user's continuation instruction
scope: Task C timing-path verification in the existing static native High scene
timing_duration_units: milliseconds as returned by the API
frame_identity: Nonzero frameStartTimestamp, preserved as an integer in CSV; deduplicated within each process
expected_result_latency: Officially four frames; poll-frame index is not treated as the original measured frame
raw_evidence: All polling observations retained, including excluded samples; files written only after measurement

conditions.build: Non-development Windows x86-64 Player with Frame Timing Stats enabled
conditions.window: Normal visible window; not hidden or headless
conditions.other_activity: Three Unity Editors are connected. Other projects will not be modified or closed; ambient GPU activity is not isolated. Record telemetry before/after each process.
conditions.diagnostic_work: No screenshots, image readback, per-frame file I/O or per-frame console logging during collection

acceptance: For each successful run, obtain the requested count of unique finite positive CPU/GPU samples under the recorded configuration, preserving exclusions and raw IDs. A passed smoke establishes timing availability only.
analysis: Count identity/validity and exclusions; summarize whole-frame GPU/CPU median and P95 plus repeated-run variation. Do not infer statistical significance or isolate PCF filtering time.
status: Planned; actual execution and results recorded separately
